use_case_name: Enter and Validate a Treatment Claim

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User enters treatment claim data into the system and validates it against mandatory requirements and master data to ensure accuracy before processing payment.

goal.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User enters treatment claim data into the system and validates it against mandatory requirements and master data to ensure accuracy before processing payment.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The system must have all mandatory master level information available and complete before accepting a claim.
The user must have the manual claim form with complete information ready for entry into the system.
The user must possess the correct Voucher Number associated with the treatment to allow automatic population of client and treatment details.
The Treatment Form Number being entered must correspond to a claim receipt detail that has not yet been entered into the system.
The MSIU Field Office User receives collected claim forms from the VSP (Service Provider) for processing.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User receives collected claim forms from the VSP (Service Provider) for processing.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User receives collected claim forms from the VSP.

The user enters the Voucher Number into the system, which automatically populates client details, syndrome treated, lab test details, drug details, and other treatment information based on the voucher.
The user enters the Treatment Form Number, selecting from a list of form numbers from claim receipt details that have not yet been entered.

The user enters or verifies mandatory clinical information including Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs (Name, Frequency, No of days, Qty), and Other Measures based on the MSIU treatment master.

The system validates the entered information against mandatory master data requirements; if any mandatory information is missed or false information exists, the system rejects the claim or places it in a quarantine area.
If the claim passes validation, the system accepts the claim entry for processing.

If any mandatory information is missed or any false information exists during validation, the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claims in a quarantine area.
The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification; if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered into the system in the following month's batch.

If any mandatory information is missed or any false information exists during validation, the MSIU Field Office User rejects the claim back to the VSP, and the system places the claim in a quarantine area.
The quarantined claim forms are sent back to the VSP for verification and correction of missing or false information.
If the VSP returns the rejected claim with satisfactory and complete details, the MSIU Field Office User enters the corrected claim into the system in the following month's processing batch.
The system sets the claim status to 'Accepted' if all mandatory information is complete and no false data is detected.
The system calculates the claim amount based on the visit type (First Visit, First Follow Up, or Second Follow Up) using fees from VSP Payment terms and drug costs from the Drugs Master.
The system automatically generates a unique Claim Number consisting of the Hospital Code as a suffix plus an 8-digit number.
The validated claim entry is stored in the database and is ready for further processing (e.g., payment).
